verdict.rationale: Dover documents an auto-generated careers page that it builds from your company website, with a desktop and phone preview. Job changes flow automatically to the posting, the careers page and connected job boards with no engineering work. Nothing in the evidence shows hosting on the customer's own domain or branding controls beyond the automatic website scan. missing for 10: custom-domain hosting, explicit branding customization controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Dover scans your website and uses the details about your company to create the page.
Changes appear on your posting, your careers page, and on any job boards connected to Dover.
Switch the preview between **Desktop** and **Phone** to check both.
